category_title: Highly reserved and anxious students with significant writing avoidance
minimal_context: The class is participating in a read-aloud discussion of mythical characters in Eric Carle’s poetry collection, Dragons, Dragons.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to have a read-aloud discussion about mythical characters in Eric Carle’s poetry collection, Dragons, Dragons. Everyone please gather for the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits in the back of the group, fiddling with books on the shelf, and rarely looking up.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please pay attention to the reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Faces away during the discussion, keeping her head down on her desk and squirming.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you have anything you want to add about the characters?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues facing away and staring into space, not speaking a word to the group.)
